verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.213
22. Akkosakavagga
Sīlasutta
“Pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks for an unethical person because of their failure in ethics.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
Idha, bhikkhave, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṁ mahatiṁ bhogajāniṁ nigacchati.
verses.english: Firstly, an unethical person loses great wealth on account of negligence.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
verses.english: Furthermore, an unethical person gets a bad reputation.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, dussīlo sīlavipanno yaññadeva parisaṁ upasaṅkamati—yadi khattiyaparisaṁ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṁ, yadi gahapatiparisaṁ, yadi samaṇaparisaṁ—avisārado upasaṅkamati maṅkubhūto.
verses.english: Furthermore, an unethical person enters any kind of assembly timid and embarrassed, whether it’s an assembly of aristocrats, brahmins, householders, or ascetics.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, dussīlo sīlavipanno sammūḷho kālaṁ karoti.
verses.english: Furthermore, an unethical person feels lost when they die.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: Furthermore, an unethical person, when their body breaks up, after death, is reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks for an unethical person because of their failure in ethics.

verses.pali: Pañcime, bhikkhave, ānisaṁsā sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
verses.english: There are these five benefits for an ethical person because of their accomplishment in ethics.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
Idha, bhikkhave, sīlavā sīlasampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṁ mahantaṁ bhogakkhandhaṁ adhigacchati.
verses.english: Firstly, an ethical person gains great wealth on account of diligence.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo ānisaṁso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sīlavato sīlasampannassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
verses.english: Furthermore, an ethical person gets a good reputation.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo ānisaṁso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sīlavā sīlasampanno yaññadeva parisaṁ upasaṅkamati—yadi khattiyaparisaṁ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṁ, yadi gahapatiparisaṁ, yadi samaṇaparisaṁ—visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
verses.english: Furthermore, an ethical person enters any kind of assembly bold and self-assured, whether it’s an assembly of aristocrats, brahmins, householders, or ascetics.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ bhikkhave, tatiyo ānisaṁso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sīlavā sīlasampanno asammūḷho kālaṁ karoti.
verses.english: Furthermore, an ethical person dies not feeling lost.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho ānisaṁso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, sīlavā sīlasampanno kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: Furthermore, when an ethical person’s body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo ānisaṁso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā sīlavato sīlasampadāyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits for an ethical person because of their accomplishment in ethics.”

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ.
